# 48V LiFePO4 Battery (48vlifepo4battery.com)

Entity statement: This site tracks 48V LiFePO4 battery prices from the manufacturers' own online stores and ranks every tracked model by price per watt-hour ($/Wh): the maker's listed price divided by the battery's rated capacity in watt-hours (nominal voltage x amp-hours). Prices are refreshed several times a day; listings are data, not hands-on reviews. Sister trackers cover 12V LiFePO4, 24V LiFePO4 and server-rack batteries.

## Core and capacity pages
- [48V LiFePO4 Battery Prices Compared by $/Wh — Live Price Tracker](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/): Compare 37 48V LiFePO4 battery models by price per watt-hour. Prices from the makers' own stores, refreshed November 28, 2026.
- [48V 100Ah LiFePO4 Batteries — Prices by $/Wh](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/48v-100ah-lifepo4-battery/): The standard 5.12kWh building block — every 100Ah model compared by $/Wh. Prices from the makers' own stores, refreshed November 28, 2026.
- [10kWh Battery: Three Ways to Build It, Priced Live by $/Wh](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/10kwh-battery/): Three real ways to get a 10kWh battery — one 48V 200Ah unit, two server rack modules, or a wall-mount — each priced from live maker-store data, refreshed November 28, 2026.
- [48V 200Ah LiFePO4 Battery Prices: The Single-Case ~10kWh Class by $/Wh](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/48v-200ah-lifepo4-battery/): The 48V 200Ah LiFePO4 class priced live by $/Wh: exactly one direct maker listing today, the variant-selector reality behind the label, and the 9.6 vs 10.24kWh trap. Refreshed November 28, 2026.
- [5kWh Battery Cost: The First Step of the Ladder, Priced Live by $/Wh](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/5kwh-battery/): A 5kWh battery in 48V LiFePO4 terms is one 100Ah module (5.12kWh). Live prices for every model in the band, what it runs, and what the next steps up cost. Refreshed November 28, 2026.
- [Price per Watt-Hour: The Only Fair Way to Compare Battery Prices](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/price-per-watt-hour/): Why $/Wh beats sticker price and amp-hours when comparing batteries — the method behind every table on this site, with worked examples from live listings.
- [48V 314Ah LiFePO4 Batteries: 16kWh in One Case, Priced by $/Wh](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/48v-314ah-lifepo4-battery/): The 314Ah class stores ~16kWh in a single 48V battery and holds the portfolio's lowest $/Wh. Live prices for every 48V 280–330Ah model, refreshed November 28, 2026.

## Guides and comparisons
- [How to Choose a 48V LiFePO4 Battery — Prices by $/Wh](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/how-to-choose/): The five checks that matter: $/Wh, BMS, comms, parallel limits, warranty. Prices from the makers' own stores, refreshed November 28, 2026.
- [How to Charge a 48V LiFePO4 Battery: 58.4V Settings, Closed-Loop, Mistakes](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/how-to-charge-48v-lifepo4-battery/): The correct charge profile for a 51.2V LiFePO4 pack: 58.4V absorption, no equalization, when closed-loop comms matter, and the charger mistakes that shorten battery life.
- [Eco-Worthy vs LiTime 48V LiFePO4: Rack, Golf Cart and 16kWh, Live $/Wh](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/eco-worthy-vs-litime-48v/): Two different 48V catalogs: Eco-Worthy's 3 tracked models (rack module, 16kWh floor battery, backup kit) vs LiTime's 15 across golf cart, floor and rack — live $/Wh, refreshed November 28, 2026.
- [48V LiFePO4 in Series & Parallel: Why Parallel Is the Only Move](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/48v-lifepo4-series-parallel-guide/): Series-wiring 48V LiFePO4 would make a 102.4V battery almost no inverter accepts — and most makers prohibit it. Parallel is the scaling path: bank sizes priced live, busbar current math, and the expansion rules.
- [Golf Cart Lithium Conversion Mistakes: The 7 That Cost Money](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/golf-cart-lithium-conversion-mistakes/): Most failed 48V golf cart lithium conversions are not battery failures — they are charger, current-rating and wiring mistakes made before the pack ever turns a wheel. The seven, priced against live packs.
- [48V vs 12V for Solar: Current, Cable Loss and Inverter Classes Decide It](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/48v-vs-12v-for-solar/): For solar, voltage is a current decision: the same 3,000W inverter draws ~234A at 12V and ~59A at 48V. The cable-loss math, the size thresholds, and live 48V prices — refreshed November 28, 2026.
- [48V LiFePO4 Voltage Chart: State of Charge from 54.4V Full to 40V Empty](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/48v-lifepo4-voltage-chart/): A 48V (51.2V) LiFePO4 voltage chart from a maker's published figures: rested voltage at every 10% of charge for a 16-cell pack, why 48V on the meter means nearly empty, and what to trust instead. Prices refreshed November 28, 2026.
- [What Size Inverter for a 48V Battery Bank? Matching Inverter kW to Modules](https://48vlifepo4battery.com/what-size-inverter-for-48v-battery-bank/): How many 48V LiFePO4 modules a 3kW to 12kW inverter needs: BMS continuous amps times 51.2V per module, the energy vs power split, and the discharge-current setting. Live 48V prices refreshed November 28, 2026.
